related_questions.question: How many days after being exposed to COVID should you test?

text_blocks.snippet: If you are exposed to COVID-19, the recommended time to test depends on whether or not you have symptoms. If you develop symptoms, test immediately. If you do not have symptoms, wait at least 5 full days after exposure before testing, according to the CDC. It's also recommended to test again if your initial test is negative, especially if you still have symptoms.
